tokens.text: "Want to join" with the Diplomacy icon
When the squad would join the selected hero, "Want to join" and the Diplomacy icon replace the battle difficulty.
When the squad would offer to flee, "Want to flee" replaces the battle difficulty and the game's escape icon, the one over the squad on the map, replaces the skulls.
An icon instead of the difficulty skulls
With "Want to join" and "Want to flee", the Diplomacy icon or the game's escape icon in place of the skulls. Off: only the words.
Diplomacy details where there are any

Shows the hidden numbers where there are any: the hero's and the squad's Diplomacy points, how many creatures would join, how many times the hero's army is stronger or weaker. With the game's setting "hide the battle danger" the ratio is not shown.
Armies: the squad is {0:0.#} times stronger
Hover a squad on the map: its tooltip says whether it would join your hero or offer to flee, with the Diplomacy or escape icon instead of the difficulty skulls. The answers are the game's own.
